pm_exper_user_3769_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.question: What are some practical ways to stay hydrated while traveling that avoid single-use plastic bottles?
pm_exper_user_3769_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) If you want to avoid single-use plastics while traveling, you could carry a collapsible travel cup and refill it at public fountains or cafés willing to pour into your own container, keeping your hydration routine eco-friendly.
(b) Because you carry reusable water bottles, you might bring along a small portable water filter so you can safely refill from tap or natural sources during rural trips, eliminating the need for disposable bottles.
(c) Since you already keep reusable water bottles, you could fill them up at airport hydration stations or public fountains before boarding, which keeps you plastic-free during flights. Many airports now list refill locations on their maps, making it easy to plan ahead.
(d) Given that you prefer using reusable water bottles, consider packing a lightweight, collapsible one in your bag so it’s easy to top up from hotel filtered water dispensers or café tap water when traveling in cities.
